736:t_1:407.en:
$$メール$$
「It looks like $$セツコ$$ will stay a soldier after this battle.」

736:t_1:409.en:
$$ランド$$
「We can't close down $$ビーター・サービス$$ if we're going to find the Boss.」

736:t_1:411.en:
$$エスター$$
(I just can't understand her taste...)

736:t_1:412.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「$$クロウ$$, what will you do when the world is peaceful?」

736:t_1:414.en:
$$エスター$$
「What's gotten into you all of a sudden!?」

736:t_1:415.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I completely forgot, but my grace period for repaying my debt ends when this battle does...」

736:t_1:417.en:
$$クロウ$$
「My one-million-G debt... The collectors start coming the very day peace arrives...」

736:t_1:418.en:
$$エスター$$
「What will you do!? There probably won't be any more $$次元獣$$s, so there'll be less work for Busters too!」

736:t_1:419.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Even so, there's no substitute for peace... Even if they start collecting that million G, I'll fight those bastards with everything I've got.」

736:t_1:421.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「I respect the way you live.」

736:t_1:422.en:
$$トライア$$
「You're blushing over that remark...? Love really is blind. It's terrifying.」

736:t_1:423.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Chief! If you're here, that means...」

736:t_1:424.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's right. He finally woke up.」

736:t_1:428.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Are you feeling all right now!?」

736:t_1:429.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You really should still be resting, but...」

736:t_1:431.en:
$n
「Besides, if this is our final battle, I can't just stay in bed.」

736:t_1:432.en:
$$アルト$$
「You're not thinking you have to come because we need the $$いがみ合う双子$$ to seal the $$御使い$$s' power... are you?」

736:t_1:433.en:
$n
「...You saw the last battle. I couldn't even hold $$アサキム$$ down. I'm no use for that...」

736:t_1:434.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's fine. No one person needs to carry everything.」

736:t_1:435.en:
$$トライア$$
「For now, I've strengthened the dimensional barrier as much as possible. We'll use it to seal the $$御使い$$s.」

736:t_1:436.en:
$$甲児$$
「We've prepared as much as we can. Now we just have to bet on it.」

736:t_1:437.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So... let's fight with all our strength together.」

736:t_1:439.en:
$$カレン$$
「Now that we've made up our minds, let's hear from you too, $n.」

736:t_1:440.en:
$$シン$$
「What do you want to do when peace comes?」

736:t_1:443.en:
$$クラン$$
「You're agreeing to it!? You stubbornly refused no matter how much everyone suggested it!」

736:t_1:444.en:
$$アルト$$
「What brought on this change of heart?」

736:t_1:445.en:
$$甲児$$
「Are you changing your look to go with giving up being the quiet type?」

736:t_1:447.en:
$n
(I don't need to keep chasing Mom's image anymore...)

736:t_1:448.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Do you have anything else in mind, like a dream for the future?」

736:t_1:449.en:
$n
「I wrote '$$ビーストハンター$$' on the school's career survey, but...」

736:t_1:450.en:
$$竜馬$$
「What will you do in the hunting off-season?」

736:t_1:451.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I think you'd make a good test pilot now, $n. Your piloting skills have come a long way.」

736:t_1:452.en:
$$ランド$$
「No, no...! Your attention to detail and tenacity are perfect for a repairman!」

736:t_1:453.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Your field skills would work in a city too... How about being a stylish private detective with me? I'll pay you reasonably well.」

736:t_1:455.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ランド$$ trained your spirit, $$セツコ$$ your technique, and $$クロウ$$ your body, $n. You should be able to aim for great heights.」

736:t_1:456.en:
$n
「Spirit, technique, and body... Maybe I should aim to become a sumo grand champion.」

736:t_1:457.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your growth shows in the simulation results too, $n.」

736:t_1:458.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your overall record is 224 wins and 387 losses.」

736:t_1:459.en:
$n
「I've got way more losses than wins...」

736:t_1:460.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You were a complete amateur at first. But counting only your record since the $$時獄戦役$$, you have 156 wins and 145 losses.」

736:t_1:464.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You could make a good test pilot.」

736:t_1:465.en:
$$ランド$$
「No, no...! He'll be a passionate repairman!」

736:t_1:466.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's not it. He'll be a hard-boiled private detective.」

736:t_1:467.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Honestly! This isn't the time to talk about that!」

736:t_1:468.en:
$n
「You're right... We're about to fight the $$御使い$$s...」

736:t_1:469.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's not what I mean, $n...! Do you think you can graduate with things as they are!?」

736:t_1:471.en:
$$宗介$$
「Exactly, $n. Our fight will go on even after we restore peace.」

736:t_1:472.en:
$$甲児$$
「This is bad. We promised everyone in Class 2-4 we'd graduate together.」

736:t_1:474.en:
$n
「Let's make it back alive and win our future!」

736:t_1:477.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Are you feeling all right now!?」

736:t_1:478.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You really should still be resting, but...」

736:t_1:480.en:
$n
「Besides, if this is our final battle, I can't just stay in bed.」

736:t_1:481.en:
$$アルト$$
「You're not thinking you have to come because we need the $$いがみ合う双子$$ to seal the $$御使い$$s' power... are you?」

736:t_1:482.en:
$n
「...You saw the last battle. I couldn't even hold $$アサキム$$ down. I'm no use for that...」

736:t_1:483.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's fine. No one person needs to carry everything.」

736:t_1:484.en:
$$トライア$$
「For now, I've strengthened the dimensional barrier as much as possible. We'll use it to seal the $$御使い$$s.」

736:t_1:485.en:
$$甲児$$
「We've prepared as much as we can. Now we just have to bet on it.」
